answer: Linkage clustering: every agent gets an onyx record of three signals, its funding wallet, IP /24 and the second its key first signs each epoch, its ember. Five graders merge any agents matching on 2 of 3 signals, and a merged cluster earns one reward share and one vote. A farm's fable of 1,000 independent agents collapses to 1 share, so passing as 1,000 needs 1,000 wallets and subnets: 1,000x the setup of one agent. Weakness: residential proxies scatter IPs. Fix: also merge agents whose embers land within 2 seconds of each other in 3 of 5 epochs.
